messages:
Samir K.: Heads-up — noticed a spike of 403s in prod when Okta SAML returns for several users. Started ~22:10 UTC after the RBAC prune job.
Elaine R.: ugh. Which attribute is missing? roles? groups?
Samir K.: Logs show empty <Attribute Name="roles"> or the attribute not present at all. Example from assertion dump: 
```xml
<saml:AttributeStatement>
  <saml:Attribute Name="email">...
  <saml:Attribute Name="roles"></saml:Attribute>
</saml:AttributeStatement>
```
Ben (infra): That matches the SCIM provisioning diff I pulled — several users had extId normalized to blank during RBAC prune step. Possible mapping rule dropped for service accounts.
Maria (SRE): Any KMS decrypt errors around the same time? If assertion claims are encrypted we might be failing to decrypt and dropping claims.
Samir K.: Checked: no kms::decrypt 5xx spikes, but there are a few WARNs in the auth proxy: 
```
auth-proxy WARN attribute-parser: claim missing for user=uid-1234, expected roles
```
Ben (infra): I also saw a handful of 401s from the SCIM worker to IdP with TLS handshake errors (mtls) earlier — could be a transient that caused the pruning job to mark mappings as stale.
Elaine R.: I'm going to query the SCIM audit log for provisioning events between 21:50-22:20 and check for the mapping rule id. If the prune job removed group->role mapping, that would explain it.
sec-bot: incident created: INC-2026-142 — SAML role attributes missing after RBAC prune :alert:
Maria (SRE): Quick mitigation: can we roll back the RBAC prune or re-enable the mapping service? Rolling back would reintroduce old mappings instantly.
Ben (infra): Yes, we can revert the pruning mutation in infra-config. It requires a canary restart of mapping-service in eu-west-1 to pick up the old config. I can do that in 5m.
Elaine R.: Meanwhile I'll run a SCIM backfill for affected users: `scimctl backfill --filter='externalId in (..)' --preserve-roles` — will take ~6-8 mins.
Samir K.: Good. Also let's validate there's no KMS alias rotation in flight. I saw a note in the rotation tracker but it was scheduled for next week.
Ben (infra): Confirmed no KMS key rotation at that time. The TLS errors were likely from ephemeral cert renewal on the IdP side.
Maria (SRE): After rollback + backfill, I'll monitor the auth gateway and watch for 200s. If we see any lingering users missing roles, we should trigger a full SCIM resync.
Elaine R.: Running a dry-run of backfill now, will post results.
Samir K.: Thanks. Postgres query to enumerate affected accounts: `select uid,email from users where last_auth_at > '2026-03-20' and roles = '{}';`
Elaine R.: Dry-run found ~72 accounts across two orgs. Backfill started.
sec-bot: update INC-2026-142: mitigation in progress — rollback scheduled, backfill running.
Ben (infra): Rolling back prune change now, mapping-service canary restarting.
Maria (SRE): Canary reports healthy. auth gateway 200s restored for the canary subset.
Elaine R.: Backfill completed — 72 users updated, roles populated. Spot-checked assertions now show roles attribute present.
Samir K.: Confirmed production error rate for SAML auth dropped to baseline. Great work.
Maria (SRE): Follow-ups: add an extra guard in the prune job to avoid dropping mappings if SCIM healthcheck flags TLS errors; add an audit alert when attribute mapping rule is modified.
Ben (infra): I'll open a PR for prune-job validation and add a CI check to block removal when live mappings exist.
Elaine R.: I'll add a post-change smoke test that runs against a small sample org to catch this earlier.
Samir K.: Closing for now, leaving INC-2026-142 open until postmortem. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
